{{RegionInfobox |regioncolor=water |name=Decolore Islands |jname=デコロラ諸島 |tmname=Decolora Archipelago |region=no |image=Decolore.png |caption= |introduction=[[Pokémon animated series]] |series=''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'' |season=[[S16|Adventures in Unova and Beyond]] (16) | }} The '''Decolore Islands''' (Japanese: '''デコロラ諸島''' ''Decolora Archipelago'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive [[region]] consisting of a large chain of islands. It is located between [[Unova]] and [[Kanto]]. It is inhabited by {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that can be found in Kanto, [[Johto]], [[Hoenn]], [[Sinnoh]], and Unova. The archipelago is sparsely populated, having only some coastal towns and many nature preserves. The region first appeared in ''[[BW123|Farewell, Unova! Setting Sail For New Adventures!]]'' when {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} decide to visit the Decolore Islands in order to travel together from [[Nuvema Town]] to [[Vermilion City]].
